planner.title: Plan for {period}
planner.closedNotice: Closed plan: it is read-only now, like the expenses dated in {period}.
planner.empty: This plan has no lines yet.
planner.activateHint: While in draft, the plan does not change how expenses are split. Once active, “By the plan” becomes the default split.
planner.closeHint: It can be closed once the period is over, from {date}.
planner.invalidLines: It cannot be activated: check the allocation of {lines}.
planner.invalidAllocationSum: Invalid allocation: it adds up to {sum}
planner.noCategories: No categories: it counts no expense
planner.orphansHint: This spending in {period} counts in no line.
planner.assignHint: From now on, its expenses count in the line you choose.

confirmActivate.title: Activate the plan for {period}?
confirmActivate.splitDefault: “By the plan” becomes the default split
confirmActivate.countsAgainst: Expenses in {period} count against the lines
confirmActivate.stillEditable: You can keep editing it while it is active

confirmClose.title: Close the plan for {period}?
confirmClose.readOnly: It becomes read-only, like the expenses dated in {period}
confirmClose.leftover: What is left over moves on by each line's rule

hint.ROLLOVER: What is left moves to the next period and does not count against capacity. Use it to save every month for a yearly bill, such as SOAT, property tax or insurance.
hint.ADJUSTED: If you go over, the excess comes off the next period; what is left does not move.

rollover.throughCopy: It moves when the next plan is created as a copy of this one and this one is closed.

copy.title: Copied from the previous plan
copy.body: Same lines, amounts, rules and capacities. What can no longer be used was left out:
copy.bodyComplete: Same lines, amounts, rules and capacities.
copy.droppedAccount: A savings account of {line} that can no longer be used
copy.droppedLine: The line {name}: none of its savings accounts is still available

capacity.title: What each one puts in
capacity.subtitle: What each person puts in for {period}
capacity.suggestion: Suggested {amount}: your income of {period} in Personal. Only you see it.
capacity.zeroNote: Anyone who puts nothing in counts as {zero}.
capacity.rolesNote: A Member changes only their own; an Owner or an Admin changes everyone's.

lineEditor.title: Line {name}

field.name: Name
field.plannedHint: {share} of what is put in · {unallocated} left to assign
field.noSavingsAccounts: You have no savings accounts in {currency}. Create one in Accounts.
field.catchAllHint: Takes the expenses of categories that are in no other line.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.explain: The line leaves the plan, and its expenses go to Unbudgeted or to the everything-else line.

lineEditor.readOnly: Only an Owner or an Admin edits the lines of an open plan.

fundingHint.DIRECT: Whoever makes the expense pays it from their own account.
fundingHint.SHARED_FUND: Paid with the money each one puts into the shared fund.
fundingHint.SAVINGS: Set aside in a savings account instead of being spent.

allocation.title: Who answers for the line
allocation.noCapacity: Nobody puts anything into this plan: allocate by percentage or by fixed amount.

note.PROPORTIONAL: Follows what each member puts in. It is recalculated when the contributions change.
note.FIXED: Amounts that add up to the {planned} planned.
note.NONE: Group money with no one answering per person: the line shows planned, spent and available, without amounts per member.

trend.noPlan: This period has no plan: there are no lines to compare.
trend.linesNote: Each line is compared with the line it was copied from in the previous plan. Unbudgeted spending has no trend.
trend.hint: Hover or drag over a point to see its value.

calendar.title: Next {days} days
calendar.explain: The recurring movements of your accounts in all your spaces, with the balance you would have after each day.
calendar.noEffect: Does not change your available money
calendar.empty: Nothing is scheduled in the next {days} days.
calendar.otherCurrency: {space} uses {currency}: its movements are not added here.
calendar.emptyHint: Schedule your rent, your bills or your salary and see here how your balance turns out.

unified.consumptionHint: What was for you: your expenses and your share of shared ones.
unified.whyDifferentAnswer: What you paid is what left your pockets, even when it was for others or for the shared fund. What you spent is only what was for you.
unified.empty: You consumed nothing in this period.
unified.otherCurrency: {name} is in {currency} and is not added here.

byGroup.spaceNote: Every expense of the space, whoever paid. Income, transfers, fund contributions and settlements do not count.
byGroup.personalNote: Your expenses and your share of shared ones, across all your spaces. Hearth's own groups are merged; groups a space created carry its name.

fund.title: Fund contributions
fund.noPlan: Without a plan, nobody has an expected contribution.
fund.note: Expected: what each one is assigned on the lines paid from the fund. Contributions dated in the period count.

lines.caption: Planned, spent and available per line
lines.carryOverPending: Carries over from {period} once that plan is closed.
lines.unbudgetedCaption: Spent {spent} in categories with no line
lines.unbudgetedCaptionIn: Spent {spent} in categories with no line · {categories}

noPlan.title: {period} has no plan
noPlan.body: Without a plan, everything spent in {period} shows as Unbudgeted and the default split is equal shares.
noPlan.managersOnly: Only an Owner or an Admin can create the plan.
noPlan.managersSee: Only an Owner or an Admin sees these actions.

matrix.noPlan: This period has no plan: there are no allocations to compare.
matrix.savingsNote: It counts what reached the line's savings accounts; it has no consumption.

overview.matrixNote: Lines paid from the fund track contributions under Fund contributions; savings lines count what reached their accounts.

reason.NOT_ALLOCATED: Not allocated per person: only what was consumed is shown.
reason.TRACKED_AT_FUND_LEVEL: Contributions and gaps are tracked at the fund, not per line.
reason.INVALID_ALLOCATION: This line's allocation does not add up: nobody has an assigned amount.
